certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: All Hive hosting is ISO 27001 accredited

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Hive Technology, Inc. complies with the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (EU-U.S. DPF), the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. DPF, and the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (Swiss-U.S. DPF); EU-based data controllers can request a Data Processing Agreement

certifications.name: HIPAA

certifications.name: CCPA Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Users must comply with Data Processing Addendum if their data includes GDPR-protected personal information or CCPA-regulated personal information

privacy.ai_training_note: Buzz AI does not train on customer workspace data. Conversations with Buzz are processed in real-time and never stored by third-party LLM providers. Zero data retention for third-party model providers.
privacy.data_region: United States and other locations outside user's jurisdiction; EU/Swiss data transfers comply with Data Privacy Framework principles and Standard Contractual Clauses

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: 256-bit SSL/TLS encryption at every network entry-point; TLS 1.3 for Buzz AI communications

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Data encoded upon arrival at servers; information encrypted before transmission

security.name: Data Backup & Redundancy
security.value: Hourly data backups with local snapshots maintained; N+1 redundancy for 100% data integrity

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Industry-standard password and authentication mechanisms; progressive user authentication on every request; multi-factor authentication supported

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: Comprehensive audit logging of all user actions with anomaly detection and alerting; Buzz interactions fully auditable

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Workspace isolation preventing unauthorized access; permission-aware Buzz access (AI respects user permissions); role-based access control

security.name: Vulnerability Management
security.value: Vulnerability Disclosure Program accepting security reports with severity-based bounty compensation; regular security updates and patching

security.name: Shared Resource Protection
security.value: 60-minute expiring links for shared resources; search engine indexing disabled for application data
